messages:
Kyra Borges: Hey everyone! I'm Kyra — just joined as a Platform Reliability engineer. Remote in Portland, obsessed with morning coffee and learning the ukulele. Excited to be here :wave: Any tips for the best local coffee shops or Friday socials?
Lena Park: Welcome Kyra! :tada: Common Grounds on NE 12th is a favorite. Also there’s a small ukulele meetup in our org — you should totally come.
Marcus Li: Hey Kyra — welcome aboard! If you want a quick runthrough of our infra dashboards ping me. Also, huge ukulele nerd here :ukulele:
Tess (People Ops): Welcome! We'll send the onboarding calendar invite for tomorrow at 10am. Quick question: t-shirt size and mailing address for swag? :tshirt:
Ben O'Neil: Welcome Kyra! We do a casual weekly "kitchen table" lunch on Thursdays (no pressure). If you like board games we bring one sometimes :board_game:
Kyra Borges: Thanks everyone! T-shirt size M. Mailing address DM'd Tess. For badge pickup — I'm remote but heading to SF next month, who should I coordinate with?
Tess (People Ops): Perfect, got the DM. DM me your travel dates and I'll arrange a badge handoff with the office admin. Also adding you to our socials channels.
welcome-bot: :confetti_ball: Kyra has been added to #ukulele-jam, #coffee-nerds, and #platform-builds. Automated welcome gift scheduled: 1x sticker pack + 1x enamel pin.
Marcus Li: Also — join #coffee-nerds if you want obscure roaster recs and roast swap threads :nerd_face:
Lena Park: FYI we have a virtual ukulele jam this Friday at 5pm PT. Link posted in #ukulele-jam.
Kyra Borges: Sweet — I'll be there Friday! What time do people usually do the casual lunch? :smile:
Ben O'Neil: Usually noon PT, but we rotate people/times. See you Friday and enjoy Portland coffee until then! :coffee:
